hints.text: Picture a number line. The greater of two numbers is always the one farther to the right.
$-3$ is on the left side of $0$ and $1$ is on the right side of $0$. Decide which of them is farther right.
$1$ is to the right of $-3$, so $1$ is the greater number.

explanation: On a number line, every negative number is to the left of $0$ and every positive number is to the right.
So $-3$ is left of $0$ and $1$ is right of $0$, which puts $1$ farther right.
A positive number is always greater than a negative one, so $1 > -3$ and the answer is $1$.
